protocol.status: Prepared separate deterministic-allocation response diagnostic, not submitted yet
protocol.purpose: Measure same-state response under an explicit deterministic SEGA allocation numerical policy; strict history/no-op/endpoint checks unchanged. No efficacy claim.
protocol.backbone: FLUX.1-Krea-dev transformer 8162a9c7b05a641be098422bf2fcf335615c2f28 with FLUX.1-dev text encoders/VAE
protocol.controls: One middle occupied RoPE octave per spatial axis, sorted by exponent, with affected-axis gain-vector RMS preservation in FP32 before BF16 casting, not query/key activation-energy preservation. Plus shared spatial scalar control. Hold actual baseline SEGA gain fixed for replays, index axis unchanged. Positive intervention gains are not reclipped to one.
acceptance_for_interpretation: Unperturbed same-state velocity replay must be bitwise identical.
Final baseline and instrumented trajectory endpoints and gain histories must be bitwise/exactly equal.
All prespecified steps and forward calls must be accounted for.
protocol.analysis: Report signed finite-difference directional response along the normalized gain path, including BF16 quantization; cross-axis response fraction and held-aside half-step residual against zero-change predictor. Record baseline and realized FP32/BF16 gains. Three controls do not identify the whole reachable subspace. No automatic candidate selection or confirmation.

planned_allocation.basis: CR14 current4Kforward~6.5sec;95full4Kcalls plus21smokecalls and two model loads per prompt. Diagnostic accounting only.

submission_conditions: Preserve originalCR14/CR15/CR16sources and protocols; fresh64 unused.
Login guard and refreshed taccinfo before submission, below96percentburn.
Register actualjob and newtaskq_response_deterministic spool in existingwatcher beforewaiting.

prior_art.checked: Sections4.1-4.2; released allocation at ddaab08552c7b7ceba2ebd8f579a0f65dee90b5e in flux_sega/transformer_flux.py lines103-154 and feature projection near691-746.
prior_art.finding: SEGA maps projected-feature spectral profiles to per-pair gains using a fixed centered nonlinear allocation and clipping. The inspected allocation does not estimate a same-state model response. This is a narrow implementation distinction, not proof of novelty.

prior_art.checked: Section4 and Algorithm1, AppendixE; no official implementation link established in this inspection.
prior_art.finding: SCG modifies latent Fourier magnitudes after the sampling update toward a time-dependent reference, retaining phase. It does not use the attention-gain actuator in its presented algorithm. Its common spectral-control objective remains a direct related-work boundary; absence of a published Jacobian in this algorithm is not an exhaustive novelty search.
